coreArchitecture: Python CLI runtime anchored by Tree-sitter AST parsing (repomap.py), which builds a cross-file symbol dependency graph ranked via PageRank within a strict token budget. Uses unified-diff and search/replace edit formats, LiteLLM multi-provider routing, automatic linter/test loop verification, and deterministic Git auto-staging/commits per edit.
enterprisePainSolved: Eliminates blind whole-file rewrites and context-window overflow in large multi-file repositories while enforcing an immutable, diff-auditable Git commit trail for every AI-generated change.
honestTradeoff: Terminal-only workflow with no native IDE sidebar or built-in MCP host lifecycle; optimized for tight human-steered pair programming rather than autonomous background ticket execution, and rapid trial-and-error iterations can clutter Git history unless squashed.
domationSynergy: Serves as a fast CLI co-pilot for DOMATION engineers refactoring Next.js ERP 5.0 modules (12 phân hệ) and PostgreSQL RLS migrations during Vibecode sprints, guaranteeing clean per-task Git diffs before CI review.

category: IDE-Native Autonomous Coding Agent & MCP Host
coreArchitecture: TypeScript VS Code/JetBrains extension, CLI, and React webview runtime featuring dual Plan/Act mode separation, AST and ripgrep workspace indexing, headless browser inspection, and a native McpHub host managing JSON-RPC 2.0 MCP servers over stdio and HTTP/SSE with explicit human-in-the-loop approval checkpoints.
enterprisePainSolved: Solves black-box autonomous code modification by forcing architectural Plan review before Act execution and requiring explicit developer sign-off prior to shell commands, file writes, or external MCP tool calls.
honestTradeoff: Per-action approval gates cause confirmation fatigue on sprawling refactors; execution remains tethered to active IDE/workspace sessions and can escalate LLM token spend quickly when loading large MCP schemas or subagent loops.
domationSynergy: Acts as DOMATION's primary IDE Vibecode agent for building CRM 360° pipelines and AutoData ZaloBot/Meta CAPI webhooks, bridging directly to GitHub, Playwright, and Context7 MCP servers under strict human-in-the-loop audit.

coreArchitecture: Decoupled event-stream platform (React/TypeScript UI + Python orchestrator + LiteLLM routing) communicating over HTTP/WebSocket/SSE with an isolated FastAPI agent-server inside ephemeral Docker containers or Kubernetes Runtime API pods equipped with bash, IPython, Git, and browser plugins (formerly All-Hands-AI/OpenHands).
enterprisePainSolved: Removes host-machine blast radius when running long-horizon autonomous issue resolution, dependency installs, and integration tests by confining agent shell execution inside disposable sandboxes.
honestTradeoff: Heavy Docker/Kubernetes runtime orchestration and warm-pod provisioning add infrastructure complexity that is overkill for small quick edits; headless execution struggles to verify visual UI/CSS regressions without external visual QA tools.
domationSynergy: Provides DOMATION with a containerized execution blueprint and background PR-runner for safely testing untrusted Vibecode dependencies or running automated integration suites against isolated ERP 5.0 tenant clones.

coreArchitecture: VS Code/JetBrains extension and TypeScript core engine combining Fill-In-the-Middle (FIM) tab autocomplete, modular @ context providers (codebase embeddings, docs, Git diffs), custom slash commands, and model-agnostic routing to local Ollama/vLLM or cloud APIs.
enterprisePainSolved: Enabled regulated engineering teams to deploy private, air-gapped IDE autocomplete and inline chat backed exclusively by on-premise LLMs so proprietary source code never leaves the VPC.
honestTradeoff: Repository was set to read-only/archived at v2.0.0 following its acquisition by Cursor; no longer receives active upstream patches or new IDE API updates, creating maintenance and security drift risk for new enterprise rollouts.
domationSynergy: Audited by DOMATION as a reference pattern for private local-LLM IDE autocomplete in air-gapped deployments (e.g., NavaTek local LLM workstation setups), while active Vibecode workflows standardize on maintained tools like Cline and OpenCode.

coreArchitecture: Cline-derived VS Code extension (originally RooVetGit/Roo-Code) featuring a Custom Modes state machine (Architect, Code, Ask, Debug, and custom personas), per-mode tool allowlists, Boomerang subtask delegation, MCP client integration, and automated IDE diff/terminal execution.
enterprisePainSolved: Solved coarse all-or-nothing agent permissions in VS Code by restricting Architect and Ask modes to read-only inspection while isolating file-write and shell execution inside scoped Code/Debug roles.
honestTradeoff: Officially shut down and archived read-only on May 15, 2026 (final release v3.54.0) as the team pivoted to the Roomote cloud-async agent; pinned teams face frozen extension compatibility unless migrating to Cline or community forks like ZooCode.
domationSynergy: DOMATION borrows Roo-Code's role-scoped tool allowlist architecture to enforce least-privilege guardrails across internal Vibecode agents (separating database schema design from migration execution), while relying on active Cline/OpenCode builds.

coreArchitecture: TypeScript/Bun Turborepo monorepo (canonical successor to sst/opencode) decoupling an internal HTTP session server from multi-surface clients (Terminal TUI, Desktop app, Web UI, and GitHub Actions runner), featuring live LSP compiler diagnostics, Tab-switchable read-only plan vs build agents, subagents, MCP support, and Git snapshot /undo and /redo primitives.
enterprisePainSolved: Eliminates closed-vendor CLI lock-in while coupling model-agnostic coding agents with real-time LSP type diagnostics, instant Git snapshot rollback, and native headless GitHub Actions PR automation.
honestTradeoff: High-velocity multi-client surface area (TUI, Desktop, Web, CI) introduces occasional configuration/plugin drift across releases; client-server execution still relies on external repo or container boundaries for strict multi-developer isolation.
domationSynergy: High-speed Vibecode terminal and CI co-pilot for DOMATION's TypeScript monorepos—verifies Next.js/ERP 5.0 edits directly against live LSP diagnostics, connects to internal MCP servers, and automates PR fixes across CRM and AutoData services.

coreArchitecture: Remix/Vite workspace powered by StackBlitz WebContainers (a WebAssembly-compiled Node.js runtime inside the browser tab) paired with Vercel AI SDK routing across 20+ cloud and local Ollama providers, streaming file diffs, an embedded dev preview server, and Git/MCP hooks.
enterprisePainSolved: Eliminates cloud VM/Docker spin-up delays during UI/UX prototyping by installing npm packages and booting interactive full-stack frontend previews instantaneously in-browser with full BYOK LLM freedom.
honestTradeoff: Browser WebContainers cannot execute native Linux binaries, Dockerfiles, Python C-extensions, or real PostgreSQL databases (e.g., FORCE RLS engines), and large multi-package codebases rapidly hit browser RAM and WebAssembly filesystem ceilings.
domationSynergy: Ideal rapid UI sandbox for DOMATION's Web Design & Sa bàn 3D WebGL (Three.js) client sales prototypes before exporting validated React components into production Next.js + PostgreSQL FORCE RLS repositories.

coreArchitecture: Async Python Agent runtime controlling Chromium over the Chrome DevTools Protocol (CDP), pairing indexed DOM extraction with viewport screenshots per reasoning step, supporting persistent browser profiles/cookies, custom tool callbacks, and queue-backed containerized worker scaling.
enterprisePainSolved: Automates legacy B2B portals, tax/accounting dashboards, and supplier extranets lacking REST APIs where fragile CSS/XPath RPA scripts break on minor UI changes.
honestTradeoff: Continuous DOM + screenshot vision loops generate high token spend and multi-second step latency; remains vulnerable to anti-bot CAPTCHAs, DOM drift, and prompt-injection/session-leakage risks when operating inside authenticated tabs without strict isolation.
domationSynergy: Bridges non-API legacy partner portals during DOMATION ERP 5.0 / CRM 360° data onboarding and executes exploratory E2E verification across live client landing pages and ad/Zalo web consoles.

coreArchitecture: Deterministic cyclic state-machine engine (StateGraph, typed channel reducers, conditional routing edges) featuring native persistence via Checkpointer snapshots (thread_id, SqliteSaver, PostgresSaver), interrupt() human-in-the-loop pause/resume, time-travel replay, and supervisor/swarm multi-actor topologies.
enterprisePainSolved: Solves broken linear chains and lost execution context in long-running enterprise agent workflows by persisting every state transition to PostgreSQL for crash recovery, replay, and human sign-off.
honestTradeoff: Steep conceptual overhead around state reducers, super-steps, and parallel branch merges; evolving graph schemas require careful migration planning for long-lived paused threads, and LangChain ecosystem conventions add abstraction weight.
domationSynergy: Architectural reference for DOMATION's Multi-Agent Orchestrator Core and multi-level ERP approval workflows (Purchase Order / Tạm ứng pause-and-resume via ZaloBot confirmation backed by PostgreSQL checkpoints).

category: Visual LLMOps, RAG & Agent Workflow Platform
license: Apache-2.0 Modified (Dify Open Source License — restricts multi-tenant SaaS & console branding removal)
coreArchitecture: Full-stack LLMOps platform combining a Next.js visual DAG workflow builder, Python API + Celery async workers, Redis broker/cache, PostgreSQL metadata store, pluggable vector databases (Qdrant/Weaviate/Milvus/pgvector), visual RAG chunk/retrieval tuning, and sandboxed plugin execution.
enterprisePainSolved: Empowers cross-functional ops and engineering teams to ship visual RAG assistants, prompt chains, and trace-monitored AI APIs rapidly without hand-building vector ingestion UIs and model-gateway glue.
honestTradeoff: Modified Apache-2.0 license explicitly prohibits offering Dify as a commercial multi-tenant managed service or removing frontend branding without a commercial license; full multi-container stack (API, worker, Redis, Postgres, vector DB, sandbox) carries heavy ops overhead.
domationSynergy: Suitable for dedicated single-tenant private-VPS departmental RAG deployments, while DOMATION keeps its core multi-tenant SaaS orchestration engine independent to comply strictly with Dify's multi-tenant license restriction.

category: Fair-Code Visual Workflow & AI Automation Engine
license: Sustainable Use License (Fair-code) + n8n Enterprise License (.ee files)
coreArchitecture: Node.js/TypeScript DAG workflow engine with 400+ connectors, native LangChain AI Agent nodes, webhook/schedule triggers, and horizontal Queue Mode (EXECUTIONS_MODE=queue) decoupling main UI/webhook nodes from stateless workers via BullMQ + Redis and PostgreSQL state storage.
enterprisePainSolved: Eliminates punitive per-operation Zapier/Make SaaS bills for high-volume lead webhooks, CRM pipelines, and AI triage flows while keeping PII and credentials inside a self-hosted VPC.
honestTradeoff: Sustainable Use License is source-available rather than OSI open-source—you cannot white-label or host n8n as a multi-tenant commercial product where external tenants build workflows without an Enterprise License; single-process mode hits memory ceilings on heavy payloads unless Queue Mode is provisioned.
domationSynergy: Complements DOMATION's internal Visual Flow Builder & BullMQ stack as a dedicated single-tenant client ops bus (syncing MISA accounting, Amazon SES, Zalo ZNS, and Meta CAPI alerts) configured cleanly within SUL consulting boundaries.

coreArchitecture: Standalone Python framework (independent of LangChain) separating Crews (role/goal/backstory agents executing sequential or manager-delegated hierarchical tasks with shared memory and Pydantic outputs) from Flows (event-driven @start/@listen/@router deterministic state orchestration).
enterprisePainSolved: Bridges business org-chart thinking and code-first agent orchestration so teams can rapidly assemble specialized research, synthesis, and QA agents governed by deterministic Flow routing.
honestTradeoff: Hierarchical manager-agent delegation can trigger non-deterministic conversation loops, latency spikes, and runaway token bills if stop conditions are loose; offers weaker low-level checkpoint replay and time-travel debugging than graph-first engines like LangGraph.
domationSynergy: Aligns closely with DOMATION's 4-agent departmental separation (Lead Routing, CSKH, ERP Ops, Revenue Agent), using deterministic Flows/BullMQ as the IF/ELSE backbone while borrowing CrewAI role-delegation patterns for multi-step reporting.

coreArchitecture: Layered Python architecture separating autogen-core (asynchronous actor/event-driven message runtime for distributed agents), autogen-agentchat (RoundRobinGroupChat and SelectorGroupChat conversational abstractions), and autogen-ext (Docker code-execution sandboxes and MCP adapters).
enterprisePainSolved: Pioneered asynchronous multi-agent debate and Docker-sandboxed code-execution loops for complex data analytics, automated verification, and collaborative problem solving.
honestTradeoff: Legacy repository has entered archived/maintenance transition as Microsoft steers greenfield adoption toward the newer Microsoft Agent Framework; unconstrained group chats risk infinite turn loops and unpredictable token spend without strict termination rules.
domationSynergy: Audited by DOMATION as a reference for asynchronous actor message buses and Docker code-sandbox isolation in Python BI workers, without anchoring new production services on the transitioning repository.

coreArchitecture: FastAPI-inspired Python Agent SDK enforcing static generic typing across deps_type dependency injection and output_type Pydantic schema validation with automatic validation-error retry loops, pydantic-graph state machines, pydantic-evals, and native OpenTelemetry/Logfire observability.
enterprisePainSolved: Eliminates fragile JSON parsing failures and untyped prompt glue in production AI microservices by enforcing deterministic schema contracts, DI testability, and end-to-end telemetry.
honestTradeoff: Schema validation guarantees structural JSON shape rather than factual truth, and automatic validation retries silently multiply token cost and tail latency on weak models; strictly Python-native, requiring HTTP/queue boundaries for TypeScript cores.
domationSynergy: Prime Python SDK for DOMATION's structured Lead Qualification scoring, Meta Ad Creative Hook analytics parsing, and MISA invoice/contract extraction workers where strict Pydantic schemas and OpenTelemetry traces are non-negotiable.

coreArchitecture: Modular TypeScript AI framework built over Vercel AI SDK unified model routing, providing typed Agent memory/threads, Zod-validated step Workflows with suspend/resume, vector RAG stores (LibSQL/pgvector), built-in MCP client/server authoring, local dev studio UI, and OpenTelemetry evals.
enterprisePainSolved: Eliminates cross-language Python-bridge tax for Next.js and Node.js product teams by unifying typed agents, Zod tool contracts, workflows, and API routes inside one TypeScript codebase.
honestTradeoff: Younger third-party connector ecosystem than Python incumbents; advanced enterprise ee/ features fall under a commercial Mastra Enterprise License, and teams must provision and operate their own backing Postgres, vector DB, and queue infrastructure.
domationSynergy: Natural architectural fit for DOMATION's TypeScript + Next.js + PostgreSQL stack—accelerates Vibecode construction of CRM 360° copilots, typed RAG endpoints, and custom MCP tools without introducing Python sidecar latency.

category: Durable Background Jobs & Long-Running Agent Engine
coreArchitecture: TypeScript durable execution platform combining PostgreSQL (task state/metadata), Redis (queues/concurrency), ClickHouse (OpenTelemetry logs/traces), and containerized workers supporting wait.for/wait.forToken checkpoint-and-resume across hours or days with realtime React progress streams and zero serverless timeout limits.
enterprisePainSolved: Eliminates 10–60s serverless function timeouts on long-running AI agent loops, batch payroll PDF generation, multi-day follow-up sequences, and 3D prepress/media pipelines.
honestTradeoff: Deeply TypeScript/Node-centric (Python ML workloads require subprocess or external service bridges); self-hosting the full stack (Postgres + Redis + ClickHouse + worker coordinator) carries significant DevOps overhead, and updating code for in-flight checkpointed tasks demands versioned migrations.
domationSynergy: Strong durable-execution complement to DOMATION's BullMQ workers for long-horizon human-in-the-loop waits (Zalo ZNS sequences, multi-level ERP PO approvals) and heavy INKICA/AutoData batch jobs with ClickHouse observability.

category: Official Model Context Protocol Reference Servers
coreArchitecture: Canonical monorepo of JSON-RPC 2.0 MCP reference implementations (filesystem, git, memory, fetch, time, sequentialthinking) built on official TypeScript and Python MCP SDKs over stdio and Streamable HTTP/SSE transports, exposing standardized Tools, Resources, and Prompts.
enterprisePainSolved: Replaces bespoke N-by-M tool integrations with one universal open protocol so any AI coding client or enterprise orchestrator can securely invoke files, Git, and external resources.
honestTradeoff: Explicitly positioned as reference/educational implementations rather than production-hardened enterprise servers (several third-party/DB servers were archived or split out); deploying reference tools without strict directory/network allowlists risks path-traversal or SSRF abuse.
domationSynergy: Serves as the protocol blueprint behind DOMATION's DOM Agent (80 tools), exposing ERP 5.0, AutoData Lead Routing, CRM 360°, and Meta CAPI diagnostics via scoped MCP endpoints backed by PostgreSQL FORCE RLS.

coreArchitecture: Compiled Go binary and GHCR container (ghcr.io/github/github-mcp-server) speaking JSON-RPC over stdio and remote Streamable HTTP/OAuth, featuring modular --toolsets scoping (repos, issues, pull_requests, actions, dependabot), --read-only guardrails, and --dynamic-toolsets on-demand discovery across 60+ GitHub tools.
enterprisePainSolved: Replaces fragile CLI scraping and bloated OpenAPI specs with typed, context-efficient PR review, issue triage, CI log inspection, and Dependabot auditing directly inside AI coding agents.
honestTradeoff: Loading all 60+ tools simultaneously wastes prompt tokens and confuses tool selection unless --toolsets or --dynamic-toolsets is enabled; misconfigured classic PATs with broad org scopes create high write blast radius if --read-only is omitted.
domationSynergy: Standard DevOps MCP server for DOMATION's engineering squad—enabling Cline and OpenCode to inspect failed builds, audit tenant ERP PRs, and triage Dependabot alerts using least-privilege fine-grained tokens.

coreArchitecture: Open-source TypeScript MCP server (@upstash/context7-mcp), CLI (ctx7), and Vercel AI SDK toolset connecting over stdio or remote Streamable HTTP/SSE to Upstash's proprietary hosted doc-crawling/indexing engine, exposing two precision tools: resolve-library-id and get-library-docs.
enterprisePainSolved: Eliminates Vibecode hallucinations caused by stale LLM training weights (breaking changes in Next.js, Three.js, Tailwind, or @google/genai SDKs) by injecting live, version-accurate code snippets at prompt time.
honestTradeoff: Only the client MCP/CLI wrapper is MIT open-source—the underlying documentation crawler, parser, and search backend are proprietary cloud infrastructure hosted by Upstash, blocking pure air-gapped use and introducing upstream rate-limit dependencies.
domationSynergy: Essential daily Vibecode MCP for DOMATION developers shipping Next.js, Three.js 3D WebGL sa bàn, and Gemini Interactions API integrations, while proprietary internal ERP/CRM documentation stays strictly inside private RAG.

category: Open-Source No-Code Automation & MCP Pieces Platform
license: MIT (Community Core & Pieces) + Commercial Enterprise License (ee/)
coreArchitecture: Modular TypeScript workflow engine built on Fastify (high-throughput API/webhooks), PostgreSQL + TypeORM, BullMQ + Redis distributed job queues, sandboxed custom TypeScript code steps, and isolated connector modules (Pieces) natively exportable as MCP tools.
enterprisePainSolved: Delivers an MIT-licensed, embeddable Zapier alternative that eliminates per-task SaaS pricing cliffs while enabling ops teams to mix visual workflows with sandboxed TypeScript code and AI agent steps.
honestTradeoff: Long-tail SaaS connector library is smaller than Zapier, Make, or n8n (often needing custom Piece or HTTP fallback steps); single-container setups bottleneck under heavy concurrent webhook bursts without scaled BullMQ workers, and multi-tenant SSO/RBAC lives in paid ee/ code.
domationSynergy: MIT-licensed Piece pattern avoids n8n's Sustainable Use License multi-tenant friction and aligns cleanly with DOMATION's Fastify/BullMQ/PostgreSQL architecture for building modular Zalo OA, MISA, and POS webhook connectors.

category: LLM-Ready Web Crawling & Structured Extraction Engine
coreArchitecture: Polyglot distributed crawler (formerly mendableai/firecrawl) pairing a Node.js/TypeScript API control plane and BullMQ + Redis job queues with Rust native modules via napi-rs for fast HTML cleaning, sitemap parsing, and document conversion, plus Playwright workers for dynamic JS rendering and LLM schema extraction.
enterprisePainSolved: Replaces brittle custom scraper scripts by transforming dynamic SPA websites, sitemaps, and nested pages into clean, citation-ready Markdown or structured JSON for AI agents and RAG pipelines.
honestTradeoff: AGPL-3.0 copyleft requires open-sourcing modified backend code if exposed over a network service without a commercial license; the self-hosted OSS edition lacks Firecrawl's proprietary cloud Fire-engine anti-bot/CAPTCHA proxy layer.
domationSynergy: Accelerates competitive catalog intelligence and external knowledge ingestion for DOMATION's Multi-Agent RAG—consumed via isolated internal batch jobs or managed API keys to avoid AGPL-3.0 contamination of DOMATION's commercial SaaS codebase.

category: Open-Source Async Python Web Crawler for AI & RAG
coreArchitecture: Async Python AsyncWebCrawler driving Playwright/Chromium with memory-adaptive concurrency dispatchers, BrowserConfig/CrawlerRunConfig session profiles, BM25/pruning content filters for LLM-ready Markdown, CSS/XPath/cosine/LLM extraction strategies (LiteLLM/Ollama), and built-in Docker REST & MCP interfaces.
enterprisePainSolved: Gives AI engineering teams a permissive Apache-2.0, zero-SaaS-fee crawler capable of rendering dynamic JS sites into clean token-efficient Markdown and structured JSON without AGPL licensing traps.
honestTradeoff: Headless Chromium rendering carries high RAM/CPU overhead compared to static HTTP scrapers; LLM-driven extraction adds latency and API cost compared to deterministic CSS schemas, and heavy Cloudflare/CAPTCHA sites still demand external proxy rotation.
domationSynergy: Primary Apache-2.0 web ingestion engine for DOMATION's private enterprise RAG workers—safely embedded inside dedicated client Docker nodes to index property portals, product catalogs, and competitor pricing sheets.

coreArchitecture: TypeScript MCP server (stdio and HTTP/SSE transports) wrapping Playwright across Chromium, Firefox, and WebKit that serializes the browser's semantic Accessibility Tree (roles, labels, focus states) instead of raw pixels/screenshots, allowing text-only LLMs to execute deterministic clicks, fills, and navigation.
enterprisePainSolved: Slashes vision-token spend and brittle pixel-coordinate guessing in AI QA and browser automation by giving agents lightweight, deterministic semantic DOM structure.
honestTradeoff: Live browser sessions consume heavy RAM/CPU under parallel agent loads; WebGL/canvas interfaces or poorly labeled custom widgets yield sparse accessibility trees, and unrestricted browser sessions pose security risks (unintended destructive clicks or cookie leakage) without domain allowlists.
domationSynergy: Core Vibecode E2E verification server for DOMATION—lets coding agents smoke-test CRM 8-step pipelines, checkout/VietQR flows, and form tracking after builds (paired with visual screenshot checks for Three.js 3D WebGL sa bàn canvases).

coreArchitecture: Hybrid Go high-concurrency server (ragflow_server) + Python AI/ingestion workers centered on DeepDoc (vision layout analysis, OCR, and complex table recognition), backed by Elasticsearch/Infinity/OpenSearch hybrid dense+BM25 retrieval, MySQL, Redis, MinIO object storage, and a visual Agent Canvas with grounded inline citations.
enterprisePainSolved: Eliminates RAG hallucinations on dense enterprise PDFs, multi-column contracts, and merged pricing tables where naive fixed-token splitters shred tabular context.
honestTradeoff: Heavyweight multi-container deployment (Elasticsearch/Infinity, MySQL, Redis, MinIO, typically needing 32GB+ RAM for smooth self-hosting); opinionated end-to-end platform structure makes surgical customization of core retrieval internals harder than composable SDKs.
domationSynergy: Serves as DOMATION's architectural benchmark for Multi-Agent Departmental RAG (Sales, Legal, HR, Real-Estate pricing books), modeling DeepDoc-grade table fidelity and inline citation checks before AI replies ship to Zalo OA or Messenger.

category: Modular Context & Agentic RAG Data Framework
coreArchitecture: Composable Python ecosystem built around llama-index-core and 300+ llama-index-integrations packages (LlamaHub), providing hierarchical/semantic NodeParsers, vector and PropertyGraph indices, event-driven async Workflows, router query engines, and native Docling/LlamaParse document connectors.
enterprisePainSolved: Unifies fragmented enterprise knowledge sources (SQL, S3, Notion, PDFs) behind standardized hybrid retrieval, reranking, and multi-document query routing primitives.
honestTradeoff: Aggressive release velocity causes frequent minor-version deprecations and deep abstraction stacks that obscure runtime latency tuning; remains strictly a code-first glue SDK requiring teams to separately host vector stores, parsers, and observability.
domationSynergy: Provides modular Python RAG retrieval plumbing for DOMATION's custom enterprise Knowledge Hubs—pairing llama-index-core workflows with PostgreSQL pgvector (filtered by tenant FORCE RLS claims) and Docling parsers.

coreArchitecture: Modular Python DocumentConverter pipeline (formerly DS4SD/docling) routing PDF, DOCX, PPTX, XLSX, HTML, audio, and images through RT-DETR computer-vision layout analysis, TableFormer table-structure recovery, OCR, and optional VLM enrichments into a unified lossless DoclingDocument JSON/Markdown representation.
enterprisePainSolved: Fixes garbage-in/garbage-out RAG ingestion by extracting accurate reading order, multi-page tables, and code blocks from scanned PDFs and Office decks locally without leaking sensitive files to cloud parsing APIs.
honestTradeoff: PyTorch, OCR, and CV dependencies bloat container image sizes and serverless builds; batch OCR/layout inference on scanned PDFs is slow on CPU and requires GPU acceleration at scale; narrow ingestion-only scope without built-in vector storage or retrieval UI.
domationSynergy: Ideal private, MIT-licensed document parser inside DOMATION's async ingestion workers—transforming real-estate fee matrices, HR policies, and MISA/contract PDFs into lossless Markdown before tenant-isolated vector indexing.

category: Vector Search Engine & Hybrid Retrieval DB
coreArchitecture: Rust-native high-throughput vector database implementing an optimized HNSW index with SIMD acceleration, payload-filtered indexing during graph traversal, dense+sparse hybrid retrieval, scalar/binary/product quantization, Raft-based distributed sharding, and embedded Qdrant Edge runtime support.
enterprisePainSolved: Eliminates high tail-latency, memory bloat, and recall degradation when filtering multi-million vector collections by tenant ID, department, or permission tags during production RAG queries.
honestTradeoff: Steeper systems-level operational curve for tuning Raft consensus shards, segment compaction, and quantization recall-vs-RAM ratios; lacks native ACID relational joins without pairing an external OLTP database.
domationSynergy: Powers or benchmarks against DOMATION's department-isolated Multi-Agent RAG knowledge bases (PDF price sheets, SOPs, legal/HR docs), using strict payload tenant filtering alongside PostgreSQL FORCE RLS to prevent cross-agency F1 data leakage.

coreArchitecture: Framework-agnostic memory orchestration layer sitting atop vector, keyword (BM25), and optional graph backends; OSS v3 streamlines ingestion via ADD-only extraction pipelines and lightweight entity linking to maintain evolving user, session, and agent facts across turns.
enterprisePainSolved: Solves stateless LLM amnesia across multi-week customer conversations without forcing full chat transcripts into expensive, context-bloating prompt windows.
honestTradeoff: Acts as a probabilistic relevance layer rather than an authoritative source of truth—LLM-based fact extraction adds token/latency overhead per interaction and risks memory drift, making it unsuitable for transactional ERP, pricing, or payroll records.
domationSynergy: Complements DOMATION's Omnichannel CSKH Agent (Zalo OA, Messenger, Website 24/7) by retaining buyer preferences across visits while keeping authoritative 8-stage CRM Pipeline quotes, unit inventory, and MISA invoices strictly inside PostgreSQL RLS tables.

category: Temporal Knowledge Graph Engine for Agents
coreArchitecture: Real-time bi-temporal knowledge graph engine tracking both event validity intervals (t_valid/t_invalid) and ingestion timestamps; supports incremental episode ingestion, Pydantic-defined custom entity ontologies, and hybrid semantic + BM25 + graph traversal retrieval over Neo4j, FalkorDB, or Kuzu.
enterprisePainSolved: Prevents AI agents from hallucinating outdated policies, expired promotions, or superseded customer statuses by modeling time-bounded facts and edge invalidation natively.
honestTradeoff: Incurs substantial LLM token cost and ingestion latency during continuous entity/edge extraction and contradiction resolution, plus the operational overhead of running a dedicated graph database cluster.
domationSynergy: Strong architectural benchmark for DOMATION's Lead & Revenue Agents when tracking time-sensitive B2B/real-estate policy changes (e.g., EcoLife Signature booking windows, Voucher Hub expiration, and multi-tier ERP approval history).

coreArchitecture: Lightweight graph-augmented RAG pipeline extracting entities and relations into an incremental knowledge graph paired with vector/KV stores; executes dual-level retrieval combining low-level specific entity matching and high-level thematic context without heavy full-corpus community re-clustering.
enterprisePainSolved: Fixes fragmented chunk retrieval on complex multi-hop SOPs and dense enterprise manuals while cutting incremental graph-indexing costs compared to traditional GraphRAG architectures.
honestTradeoff: Initial bulk ingestion remains sensitive to LLM extraction rate limits and prompt drift; lacks native multi-tenant row-level isolation, RBAC enforcement, and production HA clustering out of the box.
domationSynergy: Useful R&D benchmark for DOMATION's LMS & multi-department RAG assistant (IDEAS Institute syllabi, legal/HR policy manuals) where cross-document synthesis is needed, provided tenant isolation is wrapped in DOMATION's PostgreSQL FORCE RLS boundary.

coreArchitecture: AI-native embedding database rebuilt around a Rust core indexing engine (v1.0+) with ergonomic Python and JavaScript/TypeScript SDKs, supporting in-process ephemeral mode, client-server HTTP/gRPC persistence, metadata filtering, and sparse/dense hybrid search.
enterprisePainSolved: Eliminates database provisioning friction during rapid Vibecode prototyping and local RAG pipeline validation by letting developers embed vector search in a few lines of code.
honestTradeoff: Less battle-tested than Qdrant or PostgreSQL+pgvector for massive multi-tenant production clusters, fine-grained memory/quantization tuning, and unified relational-plus-vector transactional backups.
domationSynergy: Ideal for fast local Vibecode PoCs and isolated single-tenant document indexing inside DOMATION's 3-7 day pilot sprints, before graduating high-concurrency multi-agency workloads to PostgreSQL pgvector FORCE RLS or Qdrant.

coreArchitecture: Go-based daemon and CLI (`ollama serve`) exposing OpenAI-compatible HTTP endpoints, Docker-style `Modelfile` weight packaging, and C/C++ inference runners wrapping `llama.cpp` / GGML for GGUF quantized execution with automatic CPU/GPU layer splitting.
enterprisePainSolved: Removes complex CUDA/PyTorch environment setup when spinning up air-gapped Private LLMs on workstation or single-node enterprise servers for internal Vibecode and data-sensitive workflows.
honestTradeoff: Inherits static per-slot KV cache pre-allocation (`OLLAMA_NUM_PARALLEL`) rather than PagedAttention, leading to VRAM underutilization or request queuing under high multi-user concurrency compared to vLLM.
domationSynergy: Matches DOMATION's Private LLM workstation/single-tenant deployments (such as NavaTek Local LLM stations) for confidential internal HR/Payroll and legal document drafting with zero third-party cloud API leakage.

coreArchitecture: Data-center GPU inference engine (V1 architecture) built around PagedAttention virtual-memory KV cache pagination, continuous iteration-level batching, prefix caching, speculative decoding, tensor/pipeline parallelism, and an OpenAI-compatible serving layer.
enterprisePainSolved: Solves severe GPU VRAM fragmentation (20-60% traditional waste) and throughput collapse when serving dozens of concurrent enterprise users and long-context RAG prompts on private GPUs.
honestTradeoff: Demands data-center GPUs with strict VRAM capacity planning (lacks graceful spill-to-system-RAM fallback for oversized models) and carries a heavy CUDA/PyTorch container footprint.
domationSynergy: Recommended inference backbone for DOMATION Enterprise Private Server tiers handling simultaneous 24/7 ZaloBot/CSKH RAG chats, Lead Scoring, and multi-department ERP copilots at predictable unit token cost.
